In A Technology Store In Russia, A Robot Tried To Attack A Customer Who Pushed It 😭🤖 Who The F*** Thought It Was A Good Idea To Add A Kung Fu Software To Robots?! 😂

The Robot Apparently Reacted After The Customer Pushed It, Turning What Was Supposed To Be A Normal Technology Demonstration Into A Scene Straight Out Of A Sci-Fi Movie 😭💀 People In The Store Were Left Stunned As The Robot Started Moving Toward The Customer Like It Was Ready To Throw Hands.

At This Point, We Might Need To Start Watching How We Treat These Robots Because They’re Clearly Learning How To Defend Themselves 😂🤖 The Future Is Looking A Little Too Real!
